title: OSSF Malicious Packages
description: Ingests malicious package data from the OSSF (Open Source Security Foundation) malicious-packages GitHub repository, creating File Observables, hash-based STIX Indicators, and Based-on Relationships in OpenCTI.
short_description: Imports malicious open-source package intelligence from the OSSF malicious-packages GitHub repository into OpenCTI as File Observables and Indicators.
